title: Upper bound for truncated return time
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree, and let $t$ be a vertex. For every natural number $N$, the quantity obtained by adding $1$ to the average, over the neighbors of $t$, of the sum of the miss probabilities at times $0$ through $N-1$ is at most $|V|$, the number of vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The multigraph has a finite vertex set V
